text:
Ivy P: Heads-up — prepping Mariner QBR. Overnight we saw a two-part cost event: embed reindex + a reranker job, totals spiked ~3x. Need quick triage and slides for renewal.
Marcus G: saw both. embed route spike ~02:10-04:00 UTC, reranker/token-gen spike ~05:00-05:40 UTC. Different owners likely.
Leah V: are they on credits or metered? renewal in 3 weeks — want to avoid surprise.
Ivy P: credits + 10% overage buffer. Renewal conversation will hinge on predictable economics.
Connor J: immediate plan: 1) confirm sources (eng contacts) 2) 30-day projection scenarios 3) mitigation + enablement options for the QBR slide.
Marcus G: pinged eng leads (eng@mariner.ai) — they replied: "running a resync + a ML experiment rerun overnight". Sounds like a full-corpus re-embed plus rerank retrain.
Leah V: quick sketch (very rough) pasted:
```
Assumptions: baseline 130k embed units/day, token-gen baseline ~1.2M tokens/day
Embed extra-night delta: +260k units/night if full resync
Reranker extra: +400k tokens/night for experiment
30d scenario A (no fix): embeds + tokens => ~$52,200
30d scenario B (partial throttle + incremental): ~$33,400
30d scenario C (retainer + SE-runbook + experiment gating): ~$23,800
Recommendation: present B + C (retainer as retention lever)
```
Ivy P: Nice. For QBR show base / accidental / mitigated waterfall and ROI of a 30-min SE session. Also capture onboarding gap: docs lack explicit guidance on gating large resyncs and experiment windows.
Marcus G: mitigation options to show: A) soft route throttle on embeds for non-production tokens B) require an experiment window calendar & preflight for heavy jobs C) one-month safety retainer to cover accidental runs.
Connor J: can billing-bot create a soft alert at 70% credits and a hard alert at 95% that emails both CS and customer's billing contact?
billing-bot: created alerts: mariner-credits-70 (notify: customer-success@redwood, billing@mariner.ai), mariner-credits-95 (pager: oncall-billing). webhooks -> #customer-success.
Leah V: capture owners: Marcus = confirm root causes + get timestamps from Mariner; Connor = run final forecast table; Ivy = draft QBR slide and retention ask copy; Leah = enablement runbook (30 min) draft.
Marcus G: contacted eng@mariner.ai — they acknowledged experiment and will pause the resync tonight if we recommend it.
Ivy P: good. For the deck, include two upsell motions: 1) SE session + runbook (technical) 2) 1-month retainer (commercial). Add a tiny appendix: "cost-aware preflight checklist".
Connor J: I'll compute per-1k unit costs and show delta lines for each scenario.
Leah V: enablement agenda: 1) how to incremental re-index 2) embedding cache TTL strategy 3) experiment gating & preflight checklist. Will prep a 30-min sample.
Ivy P: last ask — anyone able to follow up with their AM and confirm acceptance of the runbook/retainer proposal before EOD?
Marcus G: i'll own AM follow-up and confirm whether they can pause the resync tonight. Will update here. :thumbsup:
